  (p : X → Y) (hq : IsQuotientMap p)
  (hY : ConnectedSpace Y) (hX : ∀ y : Y, IsConnected (p ⁻¹' {y})) :

  constructor

      exact hs
    obtain hst | hst := (connectedSpace_iff_clopen.mp hY).2 (p '' s) ht
